newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 10,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 10,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 10,000 tonnes of lentils from the 1996 crops for export, an official spokesman said on Wednesday.
He told Reuters an international call for prices had been issued and December 30 was set as final date to receive bids. Results would be announced on December 31.
The spokesman said that partial offers up to 1,000 tonnes could be accepted.
